description: Original hand-picked weights. Default profile. Function names are keyed by the SymPy class (sin, cos, exp, log, ...). The generic cost model charges every non-integer power, including +1/2 and +1/3, as pow_default. The CarpetX cost model charges those two exponents as sqrt and cbrt. A transcendental the profile omits costs the same as sin. Positive weights are scaled so the smallest is 100; transcendental_default stays 0.
